runs.content: Polaris beat Q3 with real operating leverage (sales +11%, operational EPS $0.95 vs $0.41) and raised FY26 guidance for a third time, yet trades at ~17x the new EPS guide with a ~14% FCF yield (WISE trimmed −4.52% for capacity).

Nasdaq, Inc. closed at a 52-week high after a strong Q3 (revenue +13%, non-GAAP EPS +18%, Index +39%) with a lowered opex guide and steady buybacks; FTNT was stopped out at $139.10 (−18.10%) the same day.
